```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse) # for {dplyr} functions
library(rio) # for importing data
library(here) # for easy file referencing
library(sf) # for shapefiles
library(lubridate) # to work with dates
```

# Raw Data
import data:
```{r}
## enrollment data (everyone)
rn1 <- here::here("data", "RN1.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
rn2 <- here::here("data", "RN2.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
so1 <- here::here("data", "SO1.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

## clinical data (everyone)
arms <- here::here("data", "arms-blocks.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
suspected <- here::here("data", "VA5.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
actsurv <- here::here("data", "VAR6.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

## serology subset
sero <- here::here("data", "ES3.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
ssurv <- here::here("data", "Serology Survey.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
```

merge data:
```{r}
## merge....prep?
### give participants a unique ID
rn2p <- rn2 %>% 
  # remove REDCap stuff
  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(rn2_pt_id)) %>% 
  mutate(ID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[rn2_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(ID)
armsp <- arms %>% 
  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  mutate(ID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[a_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(ID)

### ok these also depend on year
susp <- suspected %>% 
  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  mutate(ID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[va5_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(ID) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(mdy(va5_rep_date))) %>% 
  relocate(Year, .after = record_id)
actsp <- actsurv %>% 
  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance, var6_no)) %>% 
  mutate(ID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[var6_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(ID) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(mdy(var6_rpt_date))) %>% 
  relocate(Year, .after = record_id)
# might not need sero/es3? just says if blood sample successfully taken
# serop <- sero %>% 
#   select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
#             redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
#   mutate(ID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[es3_pt_id])) %>% 
#   relocate(ID) %>% 
#   mutate(Year = year(mdy(es3_date))) %>% 
#   relocate(Year, .after = record_id)
# these are the important ones -- the results ??
ssurvp <- ssurv %>% 
  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument,
            redcap_repeat_instance)) %>% 
  mutate(ID = paste0(record_id, LETTERS[ss_pt_id])) %>% 
  relocate(ID) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(mdy(va5_rep_date))) %>% 
  relocate(Year, .after = record_id)

### by house, not by participant
### so just get rid of redcap names
so1p <- so1 %>% 
  select(-c(redcap_event_name, redcap_repeat_instrument, 
            redcap_repeat_instance))

## big merge???
full <- rn2p %>% 
  full_join(armsp, by = c("ID", "record_id")) %>% 
  full_join(susp, by = c("ID", "record_id"))
```
